Practice/DREAM WORK

Dreamwork: Listen First, Then Interpret

Starting from the public article of Ni Nanqi, the four links of dream recording, dream listening, translation and inner work are introduced.

Rooted in Essence · Selected articles← Return to article directory

Ni Nanqi "Only when the client brings up the dream dreamwork?" 》

Dreams as Material for Inner Work

A dream may carry strong feelings, or it may present relationships and resources that the dreamer has not yet noticed. Ni Nanqi pointed out in the public account article that counselors can openly invite clients to pay attention to and record dreams, but invitation does not mean a requirement, nor does it mean that all dreams need to be interpreted.

The four links of dreamwork

01

Invite to remember dreams

After waking up from the dream, write down the characters, scenes, events, and physical sensations, saving the details first.

02

listen to dreams

Let the dreamer explain the dream completely; ask for missing parts if necessary, and do not rush to explain.

03

Translate dreams

Explore what the images in the dream mean to the dreamer himself. The dreamer's experience and understanding cannot be replaced by a universal "dream dictionary".

04

enter inner work

If the dream touches important feelings, then further explore its relationship with real-life issues and inner resources.

The dreamer’s experience is the basis for understanding dreams

The same person or object may have completely different meanings in different people's dreams. Ni Nanqi emphasizes that the dreamer has the final say on the meaning of the dream. The counselor's job is to help the other person identify clues more accurately, not to declare the conclusion for him.

The public article also reminds: Understanding metaphors is only part of the job. How the emotions emerging in dreams are felt, and how possible resources support actions in reality, also need to continue to be explored through interaction.

Continue reading

If you want to understand dreamwork from the original system of Michel Claeys, you can read The Truth of Dreams (《梦的真相》). Dream discussions should respect the privacy and pace of the dreamer.
